name: ashlar/manifesto
title: Manifesto
description: A large statement in the founders’ words, signed, with an optional small portrait of who wrote it. Mark the second half in italics to show it in the softer tone.

text.default: I spent fifteen years as a carpenter on other people’s jobs, and the clients I felt for were the ones left chasing, ringing round on a Thursday to find out nobody had been on site since Monday. When Priya and I started on our own in 2009, we decided ours would never have to chase. We’d write everything down and send it to them every Friday, before they asked.
